reviews.title: The advertisements are very long and intense, but the challenge situation is very boring
reviews.text: When I choose to put a challenge and start playing with other people, I notice that they are very slow, but they repeat themselves daily. This is very boring until I began to doubt that they are not real NASA. The second problem is that the advertisement is very long and not one advertisement, but two advertisements, and this paragraph is repeated when I want to do anything. I can say that I spend more time on advertisements than learning. This is very annoying.

reviews.title: Why Is Persian (Farsi) Not Included the Native Language List?
reviews.text:
Hello 
I was surprised to see that 
Persian (Farsi) is not available in the list of native languages. Considering that Persian is one of the world’s major languages and is spoken by millions of people, its absence seems like an important omission.

Is there a specific reason why Persian has not been included? I hope you will consider adding it in future updates.

Thank you
